cpsc_title: Alliance Outdoor Products Recalls Climbing Treestands Due to Fall Hazard
incident_description:
The consumer indicates that he was using his climbing tree stand when the cables broke and he fell twenty-eight feet, breaking two ribs and fracturing six vertebrae. The consumer had to visit the emergency room and later spent two days in a trauma center. In two more weeks the consumer has a follow-up appointment with his doctor so it can be evaluated or not if he will need back surgery.

The consumer states that the unit was used a total of about twenty times. The climbing tree stand is rated for 300 pounds whereas the consumer weighs 192 pounds.

The consumer plans on keeping his climbing tree stand for at least the next thirty days in case an investigation ensues.

cpsc_product_name: Cheyenne Products Mainstay folding metal padded chairs and barstools
cpsc_title: Cheyenne Products Recalls Folding Chairs and Barstools Due to Fall Hazard
incident_description:
I was at home, sitting on a backed barstool (I purchased it at Goodwill a few years ago. The tag says "Walmart.com" and I have the barcode) at my kitchen table when the barstool suddenly gave way and I fell, hitting my chin on the table and hitting the back of my head on the kitchen floor. I weigh 99 lbs, so I should have been well within the weight limit for this chair.
I received minor cuts on my elbow and neck.
I went to the emergency room an hour later because I was feeling unbalanced. A doctor examined me and told me I likely have a minor concussion that will improve after a few days of rest. The doctor did not recommend imaging.
manufacturer_name: CHEYENNE INDUSTRIES, INC. (dba CHEYENNE HOME FURNISHINGS)
product_description: Folding barstool with a back. the circular seat is upholstered with a brown material that is similar to suede. The frame of the chair is some kind of black metal. I bought these barstools in a set of two. In the attached photos, I have photos of the broken barstool and the unbroken barstool.

cpsc_product_name: BLACK+DECKER Model HGS011 Easy Garment Steamers
cpsc_title: Empower Brands Recalls Black+Decker® Garment Steamers Due to Burn Hazard
incident_description:
I purchased a Black & Decker HGS011F Clothing Steamer. I followed all safety precautions, and only filled the water tank to half of the "Max Fill" line. As soon as the water heated up, instead of just steam, boiling water came spewing out of the steamer head, nearly burning my hand. I have a video demonstrating this happening. I have reported it to B & D customer support but feel this requires a report to the CSPC as well.

When I tried uploading a video and photos to this report, the CSPC web site returned an error. I have the video available.
product_description: Black and Decker HGS011F Easy Garment Steamer
